page.overview:
Who is Void?

Void is a member of the God Hand. Ages ago he and his kinsmen confronted a Berserker Armor user in the distant past.

Void is very philosophical, more so than his demonic cohorts. His manner of speech is more formal and archaic than the other members of the God Hand, a testament to his age and wisdom. Much of what he has to say pertains to the flow of causality.

He is subdued in his temperament, showing no emotion even when confronted by something unforeseen by him and his kinsmen. He is also the most polite member of the God Hand, addressing the Band of the Falcon as honored guests rather than treating them as mere sacrifices.

In a distant time, Void manifested at a temporal junction point alongside four inhuman beings distinct from his current kinsmen. He and the other four beings were witnessed by an unidentified man clad in the Berserker Armor.
